answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 162091 Country: Uk Title: How to calculate business commodities for zakah? Question: I run a carpet business. Want to ask how shall I calculate for zakah, based on my buying price which I paid to wholesalers or selling price which I’m going to sell to my customers? And which will be the real value of my stock ? I’m confused that some say I should pay on buying price and some say I should pay on selling price! Answer ID: 162091 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1266/1043/L=9/1439) Sale price will be taken into consideration in paying zakah not the purchase price. Thus while paying zakah whatsoever rate is of business materials in the market you should pay your zakah as per that rate. وتعتبر القيمة يوم الوجوب وقالا يوم الأداء وفى السوائم يوم الأداء إجماعا وهو الأصح ويقوم فى البلد الذى المال فيه ولو فى مفازة (رد المحتار ج : 2 : ص: 211، ط: سعيديه) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
